level.theme: Mysterious, ancient, and filled with forgotten power. The temple is alive, and the earth itself resists the player’s intrusion.
level.setting: A sunken, ancient temple with bioluminescent coral, crumbling stone pillars, and shifting sand-covered ruins. The air is thick with the scent of brine and ancient magic.
level.player_weapon: Terra Pulse: A geomantic weapon that manipulates the earth and stone, capable of creating shockwaves and shaping terrain.

enemy.name: Molten Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Terra Pulse shockwave

encounters.hazard: The floor is unstable, shifting and cracking under pressure.

pickup.name: Echo Shard
pickup.effect: Boosts player's Terra Pulse damage by 15% for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Molten Sentinel causes the chamber to collapse, revealing a hidden passage to the next area.

enemy.name: Drifting Phantom
enemy.weakness: Echo Shard resonance

encounters.hazard: The water is thick with a strange, hallucinogenic mist that clouds the player's vision.

pickup.name: Sealed Relic Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks the player’s ability to charge Terra Pulse with a powerful burst of energy.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Drifting Phantom triggers a hidden mechanism, opening the way to the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Abyssal Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Sealed Relic Core activation

encounters.hazard: The water pressure is immense, and the Leviathan's movements trigger tremors and collapsing rock formations.

pickup.name: Heart of the Abyss
pickup.effect: Completes the mission and grants a permanent power boost to the player's geomantic abilities.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Leviathan unlocks the Heart of the Abyss, which is guarded by the final puzzle of the temple.

boss.name: The Abyssal Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the Sealed Relic Core, which only becomes usable after collecting it in the second encounter.

level.objective: Navigate the sunken temple of Xel’thar and retrieve the Heart of the Abyss, a relic said to hold the power of the Earth itself. But beware—the temple is guarded by ancient forces that have lain dormant for centuries.
level.reward: Heart of the Abyss, permanent geomantic power boost, and access to deeper, uncharted underwater ruins.

level.theme: Serene yet mysterious, with vibrant coral, soft bioluminescence, and the gentle hum of distant whales guiding the player through the level.
level.setting: A peaceful, untouched coral reef transitioning into a sunken temple hidden beneath the waves, filled with ancient secrets and creatures of the deep.

enemy.name: Coral Stalker
enemy.weakness: Tentacle Whip

encounters.hazard: Swirling currents may push the player back to the start.

pickup.name: Bioluminescent Bloom
pickup.effect: Boosts Tentacle Whip damage by +2 for the next 5 minutes.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Coral Stalker, the bloom lights up the path forward, revealing the next encounter.

enemy.name: Ironfin Eel
enemy.weakness: Bioluminescent Bloom

encounters.hazard: The shipwreck is unstable and may collapse under pressure.

pickup.name: Seashell Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the entrance to the sunken temple.

encounters.trigger: After the Ironfin Eel is defeated, the Seashell Key is found embedded in the wreck, allowing passage to the next area.

enemy.name: Maw of the Deep
enemy.weakness: Seashell Key

encounters.hazard: The temple is surrounded by a dense cloud of toxic algae, reducing visibility.

pickup.name: Coral Heart
pickup.effect: Restores full health and grants temporary invincibility.

encounters.trigger: The Maw of the Deep awakens when the Seashell Key is used, leading to the final confrontation.

boss.name: Maw of the Deep
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Maw of the Deep using the Seashell Key.

level.objective: Navigate through the coral forest and reach the sunken temple to restore balance to the underwater realm.
level.reward: The Coral Heart, which heals the player and restores balance to the underwater realm, allowing the player to explore deeper and more dangerous zones.

level.theme: Ominous, deep-sea horror with haunted ruins and ancient curses. The deeper the player goes, the more corrupted and hostile the environment becomes.
level.setting: A forgotten underwater kingdom, once home to a powerful necromancer who delved into forbidden abyssal magic. Now, the king's curse has awakened and the player must confront it before the abyss consumes the world.

enemy.name: Ghostly Merman
enemy.weakness: Tome of Undying Words (unlocked during this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Stagnant Water (slow player by 20% for 30 seconds)

pickup.name: Relic of the Abyss
pickup.effect: Increases player's damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Merman, the player discovers a corrupted sarcophagus sealed with ancient magic. The sarcophagus unlocks during the next encounter.

enemy.name: Undead Abyssal Warden
enemy.weakness: Relic of the Abyss (picked up in prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Corrupted Gas (debuff: +20% damage taken for 20 seconds)

pickup.name: Cursed Crown of the Abyssal King
pickup.effect: Allows the player to summon a temporary shadow servant during the boss fight

encounters.trigger: The sarcophagus cracks open, revealing a glowing portal to the final chamber. A deep, guttural roar echoes through the water as the true enemy awakens.

enemy.name: Abyssal King
enemy.weakness: Cursed Crown of the Abyssal King (picked up in prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Tidal Crush (random area-of-effect damage every 10 seconds)

pickup.name: Soul of the Abyss
pickup.effect: Permanently increases player's health by 25

encounters.trigger: The player must use the Cursed Crown during the boss fight to unlock a powerful shadow servant that turns the tide of battle.

boss.name: Abyssal King
boss.weakness: Cursed Crown of the Abyssal King
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Abyssal King using the Cursed Crown of the Abyssal King to summon the shadow servant and destroy the corrupted core in the center of the chamber.

level.objective: Survive the haunted depths and uncover the source of the abyssal corruption.
level.reward: Soul of the Abyss, permanent health boost, and the ability to summon shadow servants in future levels.

level.theme: Tense, oppressive, and claustrophobic. The player must rely on timing, resource management, and precise use of pickups to progress.
level.setting: Deep-sea ruins, surrounded by unstable geology, with flickering bioluminescent lights and heavy pressure.

enemy.name: Leviathan Maw
enemy.weakness: Static Discharge from a nearby Thunderclap Crystal (pickup from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: Flooded currents and unpredictable pressure shifts

pickup.name: Thunderclap Crystal
pickup.effect: Apply Static Discharge for 3 seconds, stunning enemies and dealing 200 damage

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Maw triggers a seismic shockwave that destabilizes the chamber's ceiling, leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Drowned Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Stormcaller's Tempest Axe

encounters.hazard: Collapsing pillars and toxic gas pockets

pickup.name: Abyssal Capacitor
pickup.effect: Charge the Stormcaller's Tempest Axe to unleash a lightning bolt that deals 300 damage

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentinel causes the floor to collapse, revealing a hidden passage to the final chamber.

enemy.name: Stormforged Core
enemy.weakness: Abyssal Capacitor

encounters.hazard: Electrical surges, collapsing walls, and a final tremor that triggers the chamber's destruction

pickup.name: Stormforged Relic
pickup.effect: Unlocks a powerful storm-based ability, granting immunity to electric damage for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Core triggers the final collapse of the Abyssal Vault, forcing the player to escape through a narrow fissure.

boss.name: Stormforged Core
boss.weakness: Abyssal Capacitor (pickup from the Drowned Sentinel encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the core within 30 seconds before the chamber collapses

level.objective: Navigate through the depths of the Abyssal Vault to reach the ancient Stormforged Core and dismantle it before the tectonic collapse triggers a catastrophic earthquake.
level.reward: Stormforged Relic + 1000 XP + access to new storm-based abilities

level.theme: Eerie, with flickering lights, strange whispers, and the constant pressure of the deep. The ruins are ancient and full of secrets, but something is watching from the shadows.
level.setting: A vast, dark underwater temple with crumbling stone pillars, glowing algae, and distant echoes of a forgotten civilization.
level.player_weapon: Eclipse Dagger – a weapon that deals more damage in darkness and can temporarily cloak the player in shadow.

enemy.name: Drowned Wraith
enemy.weakness: Eclipse Dagger's shadow cloak – deals double damage when enemy is caught in shadow.

encounters.hazard: The floor is littered with bioluminescent fungi that glow when touched. Avoiding them is key for remaining unseen.

pickup.name: Shadow Veil Shard
pickup.effect: Increases the duration of the Eclipse Dagger's shadow cloak by 25%.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Drowned Wraith, the floor cracks open, revealing a hidden passage to the next area.

enemy.name: Tide Serpent
enemy.weakness: Shadow Veil Shard – the serpent's scales become brittle when the player is cloaked in shadow, reducing its defense by 40%.

encounters.hazard: Strong currents in the chamber pull the player toward the enemy, forcing them to use the shadow cloak to avoid being knocked back.

pickup.name: Coral Core
pickup.effect: Increases player's maximum health by 20.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Tide Serpent releases a pulse that opens a sealed gate at the far end of the chamber, leading to the final boss area.

enemy.name: Corrupted Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Coral Core – the leviathan's corrupted core becomes vulnerable when the player’s health is at full, allowing the Eclipse Dagger to bypass its defense.

encounters.hazard: The room is filled with pulsating energy waves that reduce the player's health over time unless they are in shadow.

pickup.name: Leviathan's Heart
pickup.effect: Permanent upgrade to the Eclipse Dagger, increasing its damage by 30% and allowing it to cast a short-range shadow burst.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the leviathan, the chamber collapses, revealing a hidden cache of ancient relics. The level ends with the player ascending through a shaft of light to the surface.

boss.name: Corrupted Leviathan
boss.weakness: Coral Core – the leviathan's corrupted core becomes vulnerable when the player’s health is at full, allowing the Eclipse Dagger to bypass its defense.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan using the Coral Core to expose its core and strike with the Eclipse Dagger when the player's health is at full.

level.objective: Navigate through the sunken ruins of an ancient aquatic temple, uncovering the source of the eerie energy corrupting the ocean. The shadowblade must use stealth and precision to survive three encounters and defeat the final corrupted guardian.
level.reward: Leviathan's Heart – permanent upgrade to the Eclipse Dagger, increasing its damage by 30% and allowing it to cast a short-range shadow burst.

level.theme: Chaotic, fiery, and unstable environment with shifting hazards, explosive gas vents, and collapsing ruins that require precise timing and resource management.
level.setting: A sunken city covered in magma veins, gas clouds, and ancient machinery. The level is in disrepair, with unstable platforms and deep crevices.
level.player_weapon: Flamebrand, a volatile elemental staff that channels fire energy, capable of igniting flammable surfaces and creating fiery barriers.

enemy.name: Magma Golem
enemy.weakness: Flammable surfaces ignited by the Flamebrand

encounters.hazard: Explosive gas vents that ignite if the Flamebrand is used nearby.

pickup.name: Crystalline Fuel Cell
pickup.effect: Boosts Flamebrand's damage by 30% for 60 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Magma Golem to release a gas cloud that triggers the next encounter.

enemy.name: Pyroclastic Wraith
enemy.weakness: Crystalline Fuel Cell (from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: Gas clouds that cause fire damage over time if the player is inhaled.

pickup.name: Drowned Mechanic's Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks a sealed passage to the final boss area.

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Pyroclastic Wraith to unlock the sealed passage to the boss area.

enemy.name: Abyssal Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Drowned Mechanic's Key (from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: Turbulent currents and collapsing structures; oxygen is limited and regenerates slowly.

pickup.name: Fireheart Relic
pickup.effect: Permanent 15% damage boost to Flamebrand.

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Leviathan to restore the Spire’s energy and reveal the Fireheart Relic.

boss.name: Abyssal Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan with the Drowned Mechanic's Key to unlock the Fireheart Relic.

level.objective: Navigate the submerged ruins of the Abyssal Spire, defeating three chaotic enemies and a final boss, while managing limited oxygen and flame-based attacks in a turbulent environment.
level.reward: Fireheart Relic (permanent boost to Flamebrand's damage), access to higher-level underwater zones.

level.theme: Desolate, flooded ruins with flickering emergency lights and collapsing infrastructure.
level.setting: Underwater research facility abandoned centuries ago, now a tomb for the warden’s survival test.

enemy.name: Corrupted Aegis Drone
enemy.weakness: Electro-Discharge (triggered by retrieving a charged capacitor from the first encounter)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling tiles

pickup.name: Charged Capacitor
pickup.effect: Activates the Warden Gauntlet's electro-discharge mode

encounters.trigger: Destroy the corrupted drone to stabilize the ceiling, revealing the path to the next room.

enemy.name: Benthic Reaver
enemy.weakness: Overloaded Gauntlet (requires capacitor from previous encounter to power)

encounters.hazard: Deep water and unpredictable currents

pickup.name: Hydro-Resonance Core
pickup.effect: Enhances the Warden Gauntlet’s energy absorption, increasing damage by 50%

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Reaver to unlock a sealed pressure door, revealing the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Desolate Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Hydro-Resonance Core (must be equipped for the final strike)

encounters.hazard: Radiation surge and unstable energy pulses

pickup.name: Surface Beacon
pickup.effect: Activates escape pod or surface beacon to complete the level

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Leviathan to stop the reactor meltdown and stabilize the environment.

boss.name: The Desolate Leviathan
boss.weakness: Hydro-Resonance Core (from the second encounter, must be equipped for the final strike)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan with the Hydro-Resonance Core equipped.

level.objective: Survive and reach the surface through a collapsing underwater facility, while battling three desolate adversaries and a final boss with specific weaknesses tied to prior encounters.

level.theme: Whimsical and dreamlike, with bioluminescent coral, floating bubbles, and shifting landscapes that seem to breathe with the ocean’s rhythm.
level.setting: A magical underwater kingdom with floating platforms, glowing sea creatures, and illusions that shift and change as the player moves through the world.
level.player_weapon: Mirror of Reflections (casts illusions and reflects light)

enemy.name: Glimmerfish
enemy.weakness: Mirror of Reflections (the Glimmerfish is distracted by reflections)

encounters.hazard: Floating orbs of light can disorient the player if touched

pickup.name: Coral Crystals
pickup.effect: Increases the Mirror of Reflections' illusion range by 20%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Glimmerfish, the coral crystals light up a hidden passage to the next area.

enemy.name: Siren Mimic
enemy.weakness: Coral Crystals (the mimic is distracted by the shimmering crystals)

encounters.hazard: The walls shift and change shape, creating temporary dead ends and loops

pickup.name: Seafoam Scroll
pickup.effect: Reveals hidden paths and traps in the next area

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Siren Mimic, the Seafoam Scroll activates a hidden mural that points the way to the Coral Court.

enemy.name: Queen of Illusions
enemy.weakness: Seafoam Scroll (the Queen is bound by the truth revealed by the scroll)

encounters.hazard: The court is surrounded by illusionary mirrors that can trap or distort the player’s view

pickup.name: Crown of Clarity
pickup.effect: Restores full health and removes all status effects

encounters.trigger: After revealing the truth with the Seafoam Scroll, the Queen of Illusions is weakened and the Crown of Clarity is revealed as a reward.

boss.name: Queen of Illusions
boss.weakness: Seafoam Scroll (the scroll reveals the Queen’s true form, making her vulnerable)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Queen using the Seafoam Scroll to expose her true form.

level.objective: Navigate through the Whimsical Wreckage and reach the heart of the Coral Court, where the illusionist can reveal the truth behind the underwater kingdom’s enchantments.
level.reward: Crown of Clarity (restores full health and removes all status effects) and the ability to create illusions of your own in future levels

level.theme: Chaotic jungle with shifting terrain, wild creatures, and unpredictable environmental hazards. The player must rely on both their weapon and the pickups they have gathered to overcome the level’s increasing difficulty.
level.setting: A dense, overgrown jungle teeming with life and danger. The path is constantly changing, and the Warden’s presence makes the environment itself an enemy.
level.player_weapon: Vine Whip – a flexible weapon that can entangle foes and knock them off balance.

enemy.name: Thornback Serpent
enemy.weakness: Vine Whip – the whip's entangling effect can immobilize the serpent, allowing a critical strike.

encounters.hazard: A maze of moving thorns that block the player's path if not cleared with the Vine Whip.

pickup.name: Entangling Vine
pickup.effect: When used, it can entangle enemies for 2 turns, reducing their movement speed and damage output.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Thornback Serpent, the vines collapse, revealing a hidden path forward that leads to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Stonefang Yeti
enemy.weakness: Entangling Vine – the vine's paralyzing effect is particularly effective against the Yeti’s stone hide.

encounters.hazard: The cave is filled with echoing noises that confuse the player and their beast, forcing them to use the Entangling Vine to stabilize the environment.

pickup.name: Echo Shard
pickup.effect: When used, it disrupts enemy senses for a short time, increasing the chance of critical hits and reducing enemy accuracy.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Stonefang Yeti, the cave begins to collapse. The player must escape quickly, which triggers the final encounter.

enemy.name: Jungle Warden (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Echo Shard – the shard’s disruption effect is the only way to break the Warden’s defenses.

encounters.hazard: The jungle becomes a living maze, shifting and changing with the Warden's will. The player must use the Echo Shard to stabilize the terrain and gain the advantage.

pickup.name: Spirit Totem
pickup.effect: A powerful artifact that, when activated, allows the player to temporarily control the jungle environment, summoning vines to restrain the Warden.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Jungle Warden, the jungle calms and the player emerges victorious, having proven their mastery over the chaotic forces of the wild.

boss.name: Jungle Warden
boss.weakness: Echo Shard – the shard's disruption effect is required to break the Warden’s defenses and allow the Spirit Totem to take effect.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Jungle Warden using the Echo Shard to disrupt its senses, then follow up with the Spirit Totem to restrain it.

level.objective: Navigate through the heart of the jungle and defeat the chaotic spirit of the jungle, known as the 'Jungle Warden', while managing your beast companion and the resources you gather.
level.reward: Spirit Totem – a powerful artifact that allows the player to momentarily control the jungle environment in future battles.

level.theme: Mysterious and eerie, with glowing fungi, whispering echoes, and ancient symbols that seem to come alive when touched.
level.setting: Dense jungle with hidden paths, ancient ruins, and strange, living flora that reacts to the player's presence.
level.player_weapon: Bow of the Forest Spirit - deals increased damage to organic enemies, and can be reloaded with 'Nature's Blessing' pickups.

enemy.name: Wraith Vines
enemy.weakness: Nature's Blessing pickup

encounters.hazard: Dense fog that obscures line of sight. A hidden stone altar lies nearby.

pickup.name: Nature's Blessing
pickup.effect: Increases bow damage by 25% for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Wraith Vines triggers the vines to retreat, revealing a hidden path leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Cursed Monkey Shaman
enemy.weakness: Bow of the Forest Spirit

encounters.hazard: Echoes of the jungle past haunt the cave, causing the player to hear confusing voices that slow their movement.

pickup.name: Echo Amulet
pickup.effect: Increases movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Cursed Monkey Shaman, the amulet activates a hidden mechanism that opens the entrance to the temple's inner chamber.

enemy.name: Ancient Guardian
enemy.weakness: Nature's Blessing pickup

encounters.hazard: The temple is filled with shifting stone traps and ancient glyphs that react to the player's presence.

pickup.name: Ancient Seal
pickup.effect: Temporarily freezes the guardian for 5 seconds when used.

encounters.trigger: The player must activate the Ancient Seal from a prior encounter to weaken the guardian before engaging in the final boss fight.

boss.name: The Forgotten Guardian
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the guardian using the 'Nature's Blessing' pickup acquired in the first encounter.

level.objective: Navigate through the mysterious jungle and defeat the ancient guardian of the forgotten temple.
level.reward: Ancient Totem of the Jungle - grants a permanent 10% increase in damage against organic enemies.

level.theme: A tense, dark jungle with thick canopy, glowing bioluminescent vines, and ancient, sentient ruins. Every step feels dangerous, and the jungle itself seems to watch the player.
level.setting: A dense, fog-drenched jungle with ruins of an ancient temple hidden deep within the vines.

enemy.name: Shadow Warden
enemy.weakness: Obsidian Dagger (cracks its armor)

encounters.hazard: Vines entangle the player, reducing movement speed by 30% for 5 seconds.

pickup.name: Ember Flask
pickup.effect: Can be used to ignite enemies on fire, dealing 20 damage over 3 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Shadow Warden causes the vines to part, revealing a path forward. A faint glow in the distance hints at the temple.

enemy.name: Venomous Python
enemy.weakness: Ember Flask (ignites its scales and deals critical damage)

encounters.hazard: The ground is covered in toxic spores; standing still for more than 5 seconds causes 10 damage per second.

pickup.name: Stolen Amulet
pickup.effect: Grants immunity to venom for 10 seconds, and increases player speed by 20%.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Python, the amulet begins to glow with a strange energy. A deep rumble signals the awakening of the temple's guardian.

enemy.name: Temple Warden (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Stolen Amulet (disrupts its connection to the temple's magic)

encounters.hazard: The temple is alive — the walls move, the floor shifts, and the air is thick with enchantments that can drain the player's health over time.

pickup.name: Heart of the Jungle
pickup.effect: Completes the level and unlocks a permanent +20% damage boost to the Obsidian Dagger.

encounters.trigger: The amulet's energy disrupts the Temple Warden's defenses, revealing its core. The final fight begins.

boss.name: Temple Warden
boss.weakness: Stolen Amulet (disrupts its connection to the temple's magic)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss with the Stolen Amulet in hand, using the Ember Flask to weaken it in the final moments.

level.objective: Steal the Heart of the Jungle from the Temple of Vines, while surviving the dangers of the jungle and its guardians.
level.reward: Heart of the Jungle, +20% damage boost to Obsidian Dagger, +100 XP

level.theme: Serene jungle with lush greenery, glowing flowers, and peaceful wildlife, disrupted by a small incursion of hostile forces.
level.setting: A sacred jungle grove where the balance of nature is protected by the Warden class.
level.player_weapon: Net Launcher (can entangle enemies and slow their movement)

enemy.name: Tamed Jaguar
enemy.weakness: Net Launcher

encounters.hazard: Mossy terrain slows movement by 1

pickup.name: Jungle Spirit Amulet
pickup.effect: Increases player health by 2

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Jaguar, the ground trembles and a hidden path opens, leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Stone Golem
enemy.weakness: Jungle Spirit Amulet

encounters.hazard: Echoes confuse the player, reducing accuracy by 1 for one turn.

pickup.name: Ancient Totem
pickup.effect: Grants immunity to one enemy's attack

encounters.trigger: After the Golem collapses, a low growl echoes from the cave's depths, signaling the approach of the final guardian.

enemy.name: Jungle Warden
enemy.weakness: Ancient Totem

encounters.hazard: The guardian summons vines that trap the player, reducing movement and health over time.

pickup.name: Ember of the Grove
pickup.effect: Restores 5 health and grants a permanent +1 to damage

encounters.trigger: The final battle ends with the guardian's defeat and the restoration of the grove's peace.

boss.name: Jungle Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Jungle Warden with the Ancient Totem to unlock the Ember of the Grove and restore peace to the jungle.

level.objective: Navigate through the serene jungle and protect the sacred grove from invading forces.

level.theme: A dark, eerie jungle filled with cursed ruins, whispering trees, and spectral guardians. The mood is tense and foreboding, with ancient magic lingering in the air.
level.setting: The jungle is overgrown with twisted vegetation, and the ruins are covered in moss and ancient carvings. The air is thick with magic and the scent of decay.
level.player_weapon: Bone Staff (casts necrotic energy and summons shadowy wraiths)

enemy.name: Spirit of the Forest
enemy.weakness: Bone Staff's necrotic energy (damages 50% more if used after obtaining the 'Ancient Rune' from this encounter)

encounters.hazard: The trees whisper illusions of the player's past, reducing accuracy by 20%.

pickup.name: Ancient Rune
pickup.effect: Boosts necrotic damage by 25% for the next encounter.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Spirit, a hidden path appears, revealing the next location.

enemy.name: Carrion Warden
enemy.weakness: The 'Ancient Rune' (increases damage by 30% when used with the Bone Staff)

encounters.hazard: The shrine is filled with toxic mist, reducing healing effectiveness by 50%.

pickup.name: Soulbound Crystal
pickup.effect: Grants the player a temporary shield that absorbs 20% of incoming damage.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Warden, a low-frequency hum signals the awakening of the final guardian.

enemy.name: The Cursed Spirit
enemy.weakness: The 'Soulbound Crystal' (absorbs 40% of the spirit's attacks when equipped)

encounters.hazard: The room pulses with unstable energy, causing random status effects (poison, paralysis, slow).

pickup.name: Spirit's Heart
pickup.effect: Restores 100% health and grants 30% damage boost for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After the final battle, the jungle falls silent, and the ruins are no longer cursed.

boss.name: The Cursed Spirit
boss.weakness: The 'Soulbound Crystal' (reduces the spirit's attacks by 40% when equipped)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss with the 'Soulbound Crystal' equipped to reduce damage taken significantly.

level.objective: Navigate through the cursed jungle and defeat the ancient spirit haunting the ruins.
level.reward: The Spirit's Heart, granting a powerful healing and damage boost for future challenges.

level.theme: Whimsical jungle with floating flowers, talking trees, and glowing creatures.
level.setting: A vibrant, magical jungle where the laws of nature are playful and unpredictable.
level.player_weapon: Alchemical Flask (can be refilled with potions found in the environment)

enemy.name: Jitterbug Spider
enemy.weakness: Acidic Mist (a pickup item found in this encounter)

encounters.hazard: The glade is covered in glowing mushrooms that cause dizziness.

pickup.name: Acidic Mist
pickup.effect: Apply to enemy for a chance to ignore armor and deal extra damage.

encounters.trigger: Defeat the spider, then a hidden path opens toward the next area.

enemy.name: Mud Golem
enemy.weakness: Alchemical Flask (the player’s weapon)

encounters.hazard: The ground is unstable and may collapse with each step.

pickup.name: Vial of Clear Essence
pickup.effect: Used to enhance the Alchemical Flask’s potency.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the golem, a trail of bubbles leads toward the final encounter.

enemy.name: Whimsybeast (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Vial of Clear Essence (pickup from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: The lair is filled with enchanted vines that entangle the player.

pickup.name: Guardian’s Bloom
pickup.effect: Completes the alchemist’s journey and unlocks a powerful potion recipe.

encounters.trigger: Triggered automatically after completing the second encounter.

boss.name: Whimsybeast
boss.weakness: Vial of Clear Essence (from second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Whimsybeast with the Vial of Clear Essence, which increases flask damage by 50%.

level.objective: Navigate through the whimsical jungle, collect alchemical ingredients, and defeat the mischievous jungle guardian.
level.reward: Guardian’s Bloom and a new potion recipe for the player’s alchemical arsenal.

level.theme: A twisted jungle where time and nature are corrupted. The eerie atmosphere is filled with distorted echoes, decaying trees, and a sense of being watched from the shadows of time itself.
level.setting: A dense, overgrown jungle with glowing moss, strange time-reflecting pools, and creatures that seem to move in unnatural, flickering motions.
level.player_weapon: Chrono Lance (a weapon that manipulates time in small bursts, slowing enemies or rewinding damage taken)

enemy.name: Time-Sundered Jaguar
enemy.weakness: Chrono Lance's Time Slow ability (reduces damage by 50% when activated)

encounters.hazard: Fog that distorts time perception, causing the player to take 1 damage per second for 5 seconds upon entering.

pickup.name: Ancient Time Crystal
pickup.effect: When used, it grants the player 10 seconds of time manipulation immunity and a 50% damage reduction for the next encounter.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Time-Sundered Jaguar, the ground cracks open, revealing a path to the next area.

enemy.name: Shadow Viper
enemy.weakness: Ancient Time Crystal (reduces the viper's shadow attack to 50% of its original damage when held)

encounters.hazard: Echoes of the player's own actions cause 1 damage per hit for 3 seconds after attacking.

pickup.name: Echo Lens
pickup.effect: Allows the player to see invisible enemies for 10 seconds and bypasses 30% of shadow-based damage.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Shadow Viper, the ground trembles, and a massive tree roots rise to form a gate to the final encounter.

enemy.name: Timebound Oracle (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Echo Lens (reduces the Oracle's time-based AoE attacks to 40% of their original damage when equipped)

encounters.hazard: The altar emits a temporal storm, slowing the player’s movement and dealing 2 damage per second.

pickup.name: Chrono Heart
pickup.effect: When used, the player can rewind 5 seconds of damage and restore 25% of their health.

encounters.trigger: After the Oracle is defeated, the jungle begins to heal, and the player escapes into the light.

boss.name: Timebound Oracle
boss.weakness: Echo Lens (reduces the Oracle's time-based AoE attacks to 40% of their original damage when equipped)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Oracle while managing the time storm and avoiding the Oracle's time-based AoE attacks.

level.objective: Navigate through the cursed jungle and uncover the source of the ancient ritual that has twisted the forest into a living nightmare.
level.reward: Access to the next world, with a restored jungle and a chronomancer's medallion that increases Chrono Lance damage by 20% for the next level.

level.theme: Desolate jungle ruins with overgrown structures and eerie silence, punctuated by the occasional howl of the jungle creatures and the distant roar of the Warden.
level.setting: A once-thriving jungle temple now overgrown and abandoned, filled with the remnants of a forgotten civilization and corrupted spirits.

enemy.name: Vengeful Spirit
enemy.weakness: Ceremonial Obsidian Axe

encounters.hazard: The floor is unstable and collapses with each step, forcing the player to move quickly.

pickup.name: Tattered Ritual Cloak
pickup.effect: Reduces damage from spiritual attacks by 20%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Vengeful Spirit, a stone tablet is revealed, inscribing a warning about the Jungle Warden's awakening.

enemy.name: Stone-Clad Monkey
enemy.weakness: Tattered Ritual Cloak

encounters.hazard: The cave is dark and filled with traps that activate with sudden noises or movement.

pickup.name: Echoing Monkey Totem
pickup.effect: Increases player speed by 15% and reveals hidden paths

encounters.trigger: The monkey’s defeat releases a hidden path, revealing the entrance to the Jungle Warden's lair.

enemy.name: Jungle Warden
enemy.weakness: Echoing Monkey Totem

encounters.hazard: The floor is covered in toxic vines that deal damage over time if touched.

pickup.name: Heart of the Jungle
pickup.effect: Restores full health and grants temporary invulnerability

encounters.trigger: The Warden's lair is sealed by a ritual that only the player can break by using the Echoing Monkey Totem.

boss.name: Jungle Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Warden using the Echoing Monkey Totem to break his spiritual shield and strike the core.

level.objective: Survive and defeat the corrupted spirit of the jungle, known as the Jungle Warden, while navigating through the desolate ruins of the ancient jungle temple.
level.reward: Access to the jungle's sacred heart, which restores balance to the land and grants the player an ability to summon jungle spirits in future encounters.
